```

pi: pi_3NqKf...
```

lee: customer replied - their treasury rotated corporate card and asked for wire instructions + one-off invoice. They want payment posted today.
payments-ops: create manual invoice INV-11005 for $46,200 (current month + usage) and set due date today. Use GL 4501. Use internal manual payment API to record wire when received.
billing-bot: auto-retries paused for vitalabs_com. Manual invoice INV-11005 created and emailed to billing@vitalabs.io.
olivia: approve one-time late fee waiver. Reason: card rotation and issuer block. Approver: olivia.
payments-ops: manual API example (ops-only):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/payments/manual" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-11005","amount_cents":4620000,"method":"wire","note":"VitaLabs treasury wire 2026-03-25"}'
```
payments-ops: once bank reference provided, include it in the note and we'll reconcile. Make sure remittance email + payer tax id are on the invoice.
stripe-agent: opened Stripe case stripe_case_20260325-VL to request BIN review and reduce future auto-declines.
